title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 26: Natural disasters (Set 2)

lessons.title: học từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm Nature disasters (Set 2) ngay nhé!


Nhấn ᐸ / ᐳ để chuyển sang từ khác và 🔊 để nghe phát âm.

Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.

vocabTable.example: Complete the text, using the words given. You may make any changes to the words if necessary. There is one word you don't need to use. disaster tremble involve erupt landslide funnel Natural disasters can happen anywhere and often cause great damage to people and the environment. During an earthquake, the ground begins to 15.1 . This kind of 15.2 can make buildings collapse and leave many people without homes and in need of help. Another dangerous event is a volcanic eruption. When a volcano 15.3 , it releases hot lava, ash, and smoke, which can destroy everything in its path. Tornadoes are also very scary. They look like a spinning 15.4 in the sky and pull up trees, cars, and even houses. 15.5 are another serious natural disaster. The soil and rocks on a hill slide down, block roads, and damage villages. To stay safe, people should prepare by having emergency plans and listening to safety warnings.

vocabTable.example: Write suitable words to complete the conversation. Anna: Did you see the news about the 14.1 yesterday? Tom: Yes, it was terrible. The big waves destroyed many homes near the beach. Anna: I heard the 14.2 made it even worse. It brought heavy rain and strong winds. Tom: That’s true. And the 14.3 are doing an amazing job to help people find safe places to stay. Anna: They are so brave. I saw them moving 14.4 to clear the blocked roads. Tom: I hope everyone stays safe and recovers soon. Anna: Me too, Tom. Natural disasters are so scary.
